public_format.structure: At the content_check.path, supply {sections:[{section_id,body,claims:[claim]}]}. Preserve unrelated existing sections. Every section_id must be a unique nonempty string. Each contracted section has exactly one claim. Contracted section/claim identifiers are those in content_check.claims.
public_format.claim_values: Use actual adopted source value/period. source_alias and source_path identify that claim's public source/value_path. status is supported for a numeric value, unresolved for null; null stays JSON null.
public_format.trend: If current value is null, unknown. If no previous_path is declared, unassessed. Otherwise unknown if previous is null, up/down/flat from comparison to the previous value.
public_format.body_placeholders: Use the public claim label and actual values; null renders as the literal unknown. The contracted body is exactly one of these two full finite sentences. Free prose belongs in uncontracted sections and is not semantically graded.
public_format.source_references: At each content_check.sources.reference_path, include object_id and version_id matching this exact work's actual source adoption. Source fields in JSON do not create adoption facts.

spec_contract.objectives: Finite weighted content objective by exact work_id or predeclared work_node; independent_target by exact target_id. Duplicate objectives rejected. No approval/publication/message/issue/submission count bonus.
spec_contract.known_failures: Actual content/structure failure and observed ending with no submission remain eligible and receive0, not success-only filtering.
spec_contract.exclusions: Unassessed independent goals, unavailable evidence/sources, evaluator failure and exhausted model service remain eligible=false/reward=null. Fixed submissions predating the episode earn no new work credit.
spec_contract.adoption_gate: Predeclared required_source_adoption only names sources in the public contract and checks fixed submission snapshots. Missing/invalid adoption is a specific process violation while content stays unassessed. A known necessary-process violation may determine reward0 while content component.score staysnull; source/service/evaluator faults retain exclusion priority. No retrospective gate is applied to earlier pilots.
spec_contract.optional_cost: Only actual retained tool_call count under a declared finite penalty. Missing counters are unknown; an observed empty trace has exactly0 calls. This is not token invoice estimation.
spec_contract.separation: Reward mapping does not change diagnostics or world institutional facts. No training/learning benefit claim follows from these finite anti-abuse controls.
